raw_answer_text:
Looking at the validator errors, the issue is that each `edge` line needs an **operator** specifying the connection type. The error message tells us the options are `->`, `<-`, `--`, or `<->`.

For a network topology diagram, `--` (undirected connection) is appropriate for these links since they represent bidirectional network paths. For edges with labels, the syntax shown in the error message is `-[label]->`, so for undirected edges with labels, it would be `-[label]--`.

Here's the corrected document:

```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 topology
title "Branch office WAN uplinks"

node access1 "Access Switch 1"
node access2 "Access Switch 2"
node branch "Branch Router"
node hubprimary "Regional Hub (Primary)"
node hubbackup "Regional Hub (Backup)"

edge access1 -- branch
edge access2 -- branch
edge branch -[Primary WAN]-- hubprimary
edge branch -[Backup WAN]-- hubbackup
```

The changes:
- Added `--` operator to all four edge lines for undirected connections
- Used the `-[label]--` syntax for the labeled edges to the hub routers
